items.title: Manage an allowlist of approved OAuth apps, including MCP clients
items.excerpt: Figma Design admins on Organization and Enterprise plans can now allowlist approved OAuth apps, including MCP clients such as Cursor and Claude Code, and review app requests in a new Extensions tab of the admin console; rolling out over the next few days.
items.rationale: Primary-source Figma release: org admins now gate which MCP agents (Cursor, Claude Code) can reach design files, which decides whether a team's agent workflow is approved tomorrow.

items.title: Nevercenter releases Silo 2027.0
items.excerpt: The lightweight 3D modeler adds a JavaScript API with 100+ functions and an MCP server, letting external AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT generate primitives, edit meshes, and handle selections, materials, UVs and cameras. Perpetual licence $159.
items.rationale: New release that puts an MCP server inside a $159 3D modeler, so Claude/ChatGPT can drive mesh, UV and material edits directly; a concrete agent-to-3D workflow.

items.title: MAI Image 2.7: Frontier quality at a fraction of the cost
items.excerpt: Microsoft launched MAI Image 2.7 and 2.7 Flash at Ignite, with fine-grained edits to an object's color, material or position, transparent-background output and a Canvas workspace. It ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis image editing at 1,215 Elo; about $35 per 1,000 images ($10 for Flash), in preview on Foundry, fal, OpenRouter and Vercel.
items.rationale: Primary-source model launch with object-level color/material/position edits and transparent-background output, priced and available via fal/OpenRouter/Vercel; a new option for production image editing.

items.title: Instagram's new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos
items.excerpt: Instagram is rolling out content protection for creators: Meta will scan for copies of their original videos, including AI-modified versions, to catch unauthorized reposts.
items.rationale: New Instagram feature that detects AI-modified copies of creators' original videos; directly affects how visual creators protect published work (assigned to design only by the cross-section brief).

items.title: Tripo AI previews its H3.5 model and Polipop agent for 3D printing at Formnext
items.excerpt: At Formnext 2026, Tripo AI previewed H3.5, an upcoming 3D-native foundation model aimed at print-ready output with finer detail than H3.1, and Polipop, an agent that takes an idea through 3D modeling and print prep and sends the job to a printer.
items.rationale: New model and agent announcement (H3.5, Polipop) taking an idea to a print-ready file and printer; distinct from the 11-05 Agentic Canvas launch and relevant to product designers who prototype physically.
